title: BrandPack v1
description: What an owner on the shared tier may change about a site's look: a name, a logo, a wordmark, role colours for light and dark, two fonts from the allow-list and an image-style slot. Anything not listed here is refused (additionalProperties is false everywhere): custom CSS, sizes, spacing and borders are fixed by the shared stylesheet. Contrast and font rules are in policy.json and applied by validate.py.

logo.description: An uploaded picture shown in the masthead: the asset file name in the site's media store, and its alternative text.

wordmark.description: The site's name set in the heading font, shown beside or instead of the logo.

fonts.description: Font families; each must be in the allow-list in policy.json.

imageStyle.description: The image-style slot (PPY-1f68bf). v1 accepts still pictograms only.

theme.description: One colour per role, named for the standard front end's --papyrus-* custom properties: bg, ink, band-bg, band-card-bg, band-muted-bg, button-bg, button-ink, rule and focus.
